title: Christianity's Paradox: Jesus, Santa, and Easter Bunny #shorts

top_liked.author: @kawada1
top_liked.text: As atheists we raised our children with Santa, Easter Bunny and the Tooth fairy, but without any religion. They are all logical, critical and intellectual thinkers. I have no regrets about sprinkling a little whimsy into their early lives.

top_liked.author: @mousi3.cassie
top_liked.text: Exactly!! It's actually a well documented phenomenon that cults use to indoctrinate young, old, and impressionable people. I wish more people would point it out.

top_liked.author: @LyMB9
top_liked.text: I never thought how those cultural figures just kind of evaporated from my life when I left religion, even though I now acknowledged them as metaphor and icon, not actual figures
